question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.**

The broken parts of objects found in an ancient site
solution:
The correct answer is 'Ruins.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• Ruins - **the broken parts of objects found in an ancient site**. (एक प्राचीन स्थल में पाए गए वस्तुओं के टूटे हुए हिस्से)
 
• Destruction - **the action or process of causing so much damage to something that it no longer exists or cannot be repaired**. (विनाश-क्रिया, विध्वंस)
 
• Defects - **something that is wrong with or missing from somebody or something**. (दोष, ख़राबी या त्रुटि)
 
• Repairs - **to put something old or damaged back into good condition**. (किसी पुरानी या क्षतिग्रस्‍त वस्‍तु की मरम्‍मत करना)

 ​
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
